name: gemini-subagent
description: Managed Antigravity and optional Gemini CLI workers. Native Windows adaptation prerelease; Windows acceptance pending.

interface.shortDescription: Run controlled Google CLI workers from Codex
interface.longDescription: Delegate work to official Antigravity or optional Gemini CLI workers with managed lifecycle and durable results. Experimental Windows 11 23H2+ support shares the macOS skills and runtime. Offline and Codex-controlled read/resume evidence exists; project writes and real timeout acceptance remain pending. Development builds add version-bound agy account profiles; Windows shared reads remain unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Show Gemini worker, quota, account, or session status with $gemini-subagent:status
Retrieve the latest managed Gemini result with $gemini-subagent:result
